dialogue.text: [serious, building tension] Which means that to this bank, Jess isn't a problem customer at all. She's one of its best ones.
[serious, building tension] In 2024, that same watchdog passed a rule that could have cut this fee to five dollars at the biggest banks. Congress killed it before it ever kicked in.
It could have been five dollars?
[serious, building tension] Upstairs, the branch manager, Mr. Pruitt, is signing the monthly fee report, and he has circled the overdraft line in green, because it's the best number on the page.
[serious, building tension] So poor people pay the fees, rich people don't, and that's the whole story, right?
[serious, building tension] Not even close, because from here on up, the bank doesn't just stop charging you. It starts paying you to come over.
